bigquery.datasets.create: To create the destination dataset a recovery restores into.
bigquery.datasets.delete: To delete a destination dataset a failed recovery created.
bigquery.datasets.update: To update metadata of the destination dataset to match the backup.
bigquery.models.create: To create each model at the destination.
bigquery.models.delete: To delete a model a recovery overwrites at the destination.
bigquery.models.updateData: To write data of each model at the destination.
bigquery.models.updateMetadata: To update metadata of each model at the destination.
bigquery.propertyGraphs.create: To create each graph at the destination.
bigquery.propertyGraphs.delete: To delete a graph a recovery overwrites at the destination.
bigquery.propertyGraphs.update: To update definition of each graph at the destination.
bigquery.routines.create: To create each routine at the destination.
bigquery.routines.delete: To delete a routine a recovery overwrites at the destination.
bigquery.routines.update: To update definition of each routine at the destination.
bigquery.rowAccessPolicies.create: To create each row access policy at the destination.
bigquery.rowAccessPolicies.delete: To delete a row access policy a recovery overwrites at the destination.
bigquery.rowAccessPolicies.setIamPolicy: To set the IAM policy of each restored row access policy, so it grants access to the same principals as the backup.
bigquery.rowAccessPolicies.update: To update definition of each row access policy at the destination.
bigquery.tables.create: To create each table at the destination.
bigquery.tables.createIndex: To create each search index of a restored table.
bigquery.tables.delete: To delete a table a recovery overwrites at the destination.
bigquery.tables.deleteIndex: To delete a search index a recovery overwrites at the destination.
bigquery.tables.deleteSnapshot: To delete a table snapshot a recovery created at the destination.
bigquery.tables.restoreSnapshot: To restore a table from a snapshot at the destination.
bigquery.tables.update: To update metadata of each restored table to match the backup.
bigquery.tables.updateData: To write the backed-up rows into each restored table.
bigquery.tables.updateIndex: To update each search index of a restored table.
